activeAmendment.reason: Owner-authorised 48-hour repair following a workspace crash immediately after the administrator pressed SELF-TEST. Treat unbounded full-collection reads, concurrent controlled-PDF downloads/page rendering and unvalidated Gateway response rendering in reconcile() as the proven cause. Also deliver per-signer SMTP acceptance visibility and verify sequential next-position invitations for shared email addresses.
activeAmendment.expectedEffect: The self-test is isolated by its own error boundary; processes at most 20 documents per page one at a time, renders only first PDF page at reduced scale, releases resources, supports cancellation and enforces 15-second per-document and 60-second total limits. Gateway responses are shape/length validated and sanitised. Startup ignores/clears legacy self-test result data and displays only a short safe code plus module name on startup errors. Delivery UI reports per-signer SMTP acceptance/failure without claiming delivery; sequential next signer receives a distinct invitation per signer position.
